dogecoin.text: .@Tesla's share surged 14.8% yesterday after Trump's electoral victory, adding nearly USD21 billion to Elon Musk's net worth to USD285.6 billion, per Forbes data. @Bitcoin hit a record high above USD76,000, and @elonmusk-backed @dogecoin rallied 25% as Trump wins the White House. https://t.co/dvqcw949yc

US President-elect Donald Trump named Elon Musk to co-lead a newly formed Department of Government Efficiency, with its acronym the same as Musk-endorsed crypto Dogecoin. The DOGE will run as an external group advising the president to cut excess regulations and expenditures. https://t.co/CpIwcTsU51
